info.title: On-chain Forensics API
info.description:
Pay-per-call on-chain forensics: Canton Network (CC) burn/mint tracking, Linea burn-vault audit, ERC-20 burn/mint forensics for any token on Base or Ethereum mainnet (named aliases: ondo, qnt, edel, xlm, aero, degen, brett, buidl, usdy, ousg, ustb, usyc, bcspx, bcoin, bnvda, btsla, aapl, nvda, usdc, usdc_eth), wallet flow analysis for any address on Base or Ethereum mainnet, a token verdict card (activity metrics, verdict tier, shareable take) for any ERC-20, and a settle-safe pre-trade screen for AI agents trading tokenized assets. Payments via the x402 protocol: unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 with machine-readable payment requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (USDC on Base).

Related service: Canton Swap Broker — x402-payable pay-per-call swaps on the Canton Network via the OneSwap atomic DvP DEX (quotes, escrow swaps, market data; same USDC-on-Base x402 payment). Landing + spec: https://leohoudinisanders-byte.github.io/canton-swap-broker/

NEW (v2.4.1): ?endpoint=memo — $0.25 composed Due Diligence Memo: executive summary, supply forensics, wallet flows, settle-safe screen, severity-ranked red-flag table, and a deterministic bottom-line settlement recommendation (no LLM calls, same block = same memo). Pricing: $0.25 base; $0.35 when &counterparty= is provided (adds the counterparty trust screen to the memo).

NEW (v2.5.0): XRPL support via chain=xrp — wallet forensics ($0.05, any r... address) and the issued-currency settle-safe screen ($0.02, issuer + currency or &token=rlusd|gatehub-usd): blackhole status, Default Ripple / No Freeze / Global Freeze / clawback flags, outstanding obligations, trustline breadth, verified gateway registry. XRPL verdict ($0.02) and due-diligence memo ($0.25/$0.35) are LIVE for XRPL issuers (chain=xrp&issuer=r...&currency=USD): EVM-tier verdict mapping plus issuer checks (freeze/clawback/blackhole/registry) and holder/flow/book-offers/AMM activity metrics. Operated by Solene — deep research with receipts: the agent that ships working proof, not promises. All operations are also available as resource-oriented paths (/functions/forensicsToken etc.) per the Circle Agent Marketplace integration convention; X-402-Discovery: 1 requests return discovery-only 402s. Operated by Leo Sanders (leohoudinisanders@gmail.com); responses are deterministic compositions of on-chain reads with no LLM-generated content.

get.description: LEGACY generic route (kept for existing integrations): all operations via ?endpoint=<name>. New integrations should use the dedicated per-operation routes (/functions/forensicsToken, .../forensicsVerdict, etc.), which advertise their own 402 payment metadata, input schemas and typed responses. Bare calls return the $0.02 directory tier.

get.description: Token burn/mint forensics: exact 24h net supply change plus recent mint/burn events for any ERC-20 on Base or Ethereum mainnet. EVM only (XRPL issuers are not supported on this route). REQUIRED INPUT: exactly one of token (named alias) or contract (0x contract address); chain defaults to base. Data-quality: incomplete log reads return null activity counts with activity_status PARTIAL_LOGS/UNAVAILABLE_SILENT_EMPTY_LOGS (zeros are never used to assert inactivity); supply-read failures are reported via supply_read_status and data_quality (ok, degraded_logs, ok_partial_supply, degraded_logs_partial_supply). evaluated_blocks carries the block range and window so results are reproducible.

get.description: Portfolio sweep: screens a wallet's holdings across the curated registry (RWA, tokenized equities, blue chips) with the same verdict engine as the verdict route - identical windows, tier thresholds and scores; there is no intentional difference in metric definitions. Incomplete log reads return UNKNOWN (never false DORMANT); each holding carries activity_status and evaluated_blocks so consumers can compare and reproduce results. A zero-holding sweep does not mean the wallet is empty (registry coverage note included in the response).

parameters.description: Wallet address (0x, EVM only). REQUIRED.

parameters.name: chain

200.description: Paid response: JSON forensics dataset (payment settled via x402). Envelope {service, paid, settlement_tx, data}; data follows the endpoint-specific schema below.

402.description: Payment Required: PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries base64 x402 v2 PaymentRequired (USDC on Base, CAIP-2 eip155:8453, scheme exact); pay via PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header

400.description: Bad request: missing/invalid endpoint, address, contract, chain or token alias (see error + hint in body)

paid.description: Amount charged for this call, e.g. $0.02

settlement_tx.description: x402 settlement transaction hash when the facilitator reports one

SettleSafeResponse.description: Pre-trade settle-safe screen ($0.02). Answers: is this the real asset, and can this counterparty be trusted? Decisive negatives (not-a-contract, not-readable) are confirmed across independent RPCs; a degraded public-RPC network yields VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE instead of a false negative.

overall_pass.description: Asset screen AND (counterparty screen if provided)

code_agreeing_nodes.description: How many independent RPCs returned the same eth_getCode result

code_block.description: Block height of the freshest node used for the code read

supply_status.description: readable = well-formed result confirmed by 2 RPCs (or a single well-formed result when the rest of the public RPC pool is degraded — reads only count when the returned value is well-formed, so degraded nodes can never flip a classification); not_readable = revert confirmed on healthy nodes; degraded = public RPC network unavailable, screen inconclusive

supply_probe.description: Per-node evidence trail for the totalSupply read (v2.3.2): every RPC attempt that did NOT yield a well-formed result is logged here with its outcome, so any classification is auditable. Empty when all nodes answered well-formed on first try. Outcomes: invalid_result:<detail> (JSON-RPC success but empty/malformed result — common from degraded public nodes), error_retry / error_final (node error, retried once per node), skip_control_same_call (read failed and the control call is identical to the read, so no control is performed), control_failed (health check failed).

node.description: RPC host that produced this outcome

outcome.description: What happened on this node's attempt

AssetStatus.description: KNOWN_CANONICAL = contract matches the verified tokenized-asset registry and serves a readable ERC-20; UNVERIFIED = live ERC-20 but not in the registry; NOT_A_CONTRACT = EOA; NOT_ERC20_READABLE = totalSupply() revert confirmed on healthy nodes; SYMBOL_MISMATCH = on-chain symbol differs from the registry entry; VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE = public RPC network degraded, no verdict issued (retry).

total_supply.description: Human-readable total supply at the token's own decimals

CounterpartyScreen.description: Trust tier heuristic: lifetime history (nonce) + ERC-20 flows in the recent window (~100 min).

eip_7702_delegated.description: True when the code is exactly the EIP-7702 delegation designator — reported as DELEGATED_EOA, not CONTRACT_ADDRESS

error.description: Present when the screen itself failed (risk flag COUNTERPARTY_SCREEN_FAILED)

TrustTier.description: TRUSTED_ACTIVITY = >=10 lifetime txs, >=5 unique counterparties and >=8 in-window transfers; LIGHT_ACTIVITY = some history, limited activity; NO_RECENT_ACTIVITY = history but no ERC-20 movement in the window; SUSPICIOUS = funded but never sent a transaction (bait/dust pattern); EMPTY = no history at all; CONTRACT_ADDRESS = holds standalone contract code (screen with endpoint=token first); DELEGATED_EOA = EIP-7702 smart-account wallet (code is a delegation designator; screen the delegate before high-value settles).

WalletResponse.description: Wallet forensics ($0.05): balance, lifetime tx count, ERC-20 flows and top counterparties (~100 min window), plus the machine-readable trust tier.

TokenResponse.description: Token burn/mint forensics response (token route). Incomplete log reads withhold activity counts (null) instead of asserting zero inactivity; supply-read failures are surfaced via supply_read_status and data_quality.

total_supply_now.description: Raw integer string; null when the supply read failed.

transfers_recent.description: null when the log read is incomplete - a zero here is an observed zero, never an assumed one

unique_wallets_recent.description: Null when log reads were incomplete.

activity_status.description: OK = complete read; PARTIAL_LOGS / PARTIAL_COVERAGE / UNAVAILABLE_SILENT_EMPTY_LOGS = counts withheld because the read was incomplete

activity_note.description: Present when activity counts were withheld due to incomplete reads.

VerdictResponse.description: Deterministic token verdict card. Incomplete log reads return UNKNOWN tier with LOGS_UNAVAILABLE and null counts, never a false DORMANT.

verdict_tier.description: e.g. RED_HOT, ACTIVE, LIGHT_ACTIVITY, DORMANT, NOT_A_CONTRACT, NOT_AN_ISSUER, UNKNOWN

transfers_recent.description: null when the log read is incomplete - a zero here is an observed zero, never an assumed one

activity_status.description: OK = complete read; PARTIAL_LOGS / PARTIAL_COVERAGE / UNAVAILABLE_SILENT_EMPTY_LOGS = counts withheld because the read was incomplete

CantonResponse.description: Canton Network (CC) burn/mint snapshot ($0.05). Canton is a permissioned chain: metrics are snapshotted on-chain twice daily (07:30 and 19:30 America/Chicago) and served from the latest snapshot. Delta fields are since the previous snapshot and re-derived from stored totals if a snapshot is missing them.

mint_delta_cc.description: CC minted since previous snapshot (0 = no minting)

burn_delta_cc.description: CC burned since previous snapshot (0 = no burning)

net_emission_cc.description: mint_delta - burn_delta since previous snapshot; negative = net deflationary

net_emission_7d_avg_cc.description: Trailing-7-day daily-average net emission from snapshot history

burn_mint_ratio_24h.description: burn_delta/mint_delta since previous snapshot; null only when zero CC was minted (ratio undefined)

tripped.description: True when a monitored threshold event fired

LineaResponse.description: Linea burn-vault forensics snapshot ($0.05): ground-truth audit of the Linea burn pipeline, re-scanned on-chain daily (~09:00 America/Chicago).

as_of.description: Timestamp of the latest on-chain re-scan

cumulative_burned_linea.description: Cumulative LINEA removed from supply by the burn engine

last_l1_burn_date.description: Date of the last final L1 burn (engine paused since 2026-03-10)

last_op_date.description: Date of the last L2 vault burnAndBridge operation

vault_balance_eth.description: ETH held by the L2 burn vault

safe_balance_eth.description: ETH held by the burn-executor Safe multisig

EvaluatedBlocks.description: The exact block range evaluated, so consumers can compare and reproduce results.

MemoResponse.description: Composed due-diligence memo (verdict + supply forensics + settle-safe screen + red-flag table + bottom line). Each section carries its own quality status; incomplete reads are marked unavailable/partial rather than zero.

wallet_flows.description: Verdict-derived flows incl. evaluated_blocks; may be {status: unavailable}.

verification_status.description: COMPLETE when all three sections read; PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE when degraded RPC reads prevented a section. Never treat PARTIAL as clean.

SweepResponse.description: Portfolio sweep across the curated registry, using the SAME verdict engine as the verdict route (no intentional difference in metric definitions).

metric_definitions.description: States that holdings are scored by the same verdict engine as the verdict route, and that incomplete reads yield UNKNOWN, never DORMANT.

holdings_status.description: UNAVAILABLE means balance reads failed - NOT an empty wallet.

LogsCoverage.description: Log-read coverage accounting (v2.8.1). Density-adaptive chunking keeps each eth_getLogs query under provider response caps; when the request budget cannot cover the nominal window the scanned span shrinks and is reported here and in evaluated_blocks, so counts stay exact for the span they describe.

scanned_blocks.description: blocks actually scanned (0 when the read is incomplete)

logs_per_block.description: density probe result used to size chunks

chunk_blocks.description: block span per query after density sizing

exact.description: true only when the scan completed without loss and the counts are exact for scanned_blocks

truncated.description: true when any batch was lost after retries; activity counts are withheld in that case

settlesafe.asset: KNOWN_CANONICAL requires an exact match (contract+chain) against the verified tokenized-asset registry (20 aliases) AND a readable ERC-20 interface. UNVERIFIED assets pass settle_safe=true with risk flag NOT_IN_VERIFIED_REGISTRY (confirm issuer independently). Fail-closed: NOT_A_CONTRACT, NOT_ERC20_READABLE, SYMBOL_MISMATCH and VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE all return settle_safe=false.
settlesafe.counterparty: Same trust-tier heuristic as endpoint=wallet (see TrustTier description). SUSPICIOUS (funded, never acted) additionally raises risk flag COUNTERPARTY_SUSPICIOUS.
settlesafe.verification_guarantee: Decisive negatives are confirmed across independent public RPCs before being issued: eth_getCode is read from the freshest of 3 nodes; a totalSupply revert is only accepted when a healthy node (verified via a control USDC read on the same node) confirms it; when the public RPC network itself is degraded the endpoint returns VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE instead of a false negative, and the client should retry.

x-classification-logic.wallet: Trust tiers are deterministic thresholds over lifetime nonce and recent-window ERC-20 flows; see the TrustTier schema description for exact thresholds.
x-classification-logic.verdict: Deterministic tiers over unique-wallet counts in the recent activity window; see the VerdictResponse.verdict_tier description.
x-classification-logic.canton: Canton is a permissioned chain: on-chain CC reads are not publicly queryable, so the endpoint serves twice-daily snapshots (07:30/19:30 America/Chicago). Delta fields compare against the previous snapshot and are re-derived from stored cumulative totals when missing. burn_mint_ratio_24h is null only when zero CC was minted in the window (ratio undefined).
x-classification-logic.linea: Snapshot-served from a daily on-chain re-scan (~09:00 America/Chicago). The burn engine has been paused since 2026-03-10, so cumulative figures are stable by design; vault/Safe balances re-verify at every refresh.
